interpretation: conditional intervention requirements and physical performance; no intervention is automatically added to the frozen planning baseline
peak_load_source: EIA reported UTC actual demand; only common complete, gross-outlier-screened local summer seasons; no author filling

excluded_peak_years.2023: SPP has an unresolved 3,621,097 MW gross outlier; no credible replacement obtained, so the common year is excluded before ranking
excluded_peak_years.2024: Archived and current EIA demand retain 24 missing MISO hours and one missing SPP hour; excluded for all four areas before ranking

gross_outlier_rule: Demand exceeding 10 times the region-year finite-positive summer median invalidates the season; 5x/20x diagnostics are also archived
pv_mapping: constant 1 MW load, independent site batteries, equal representative weights; historical load-hour coincidence is a diagnostic, not capacity accreditation
net_peak_relief_requirement: max(-B, 0) / (1 + RML / 100), effective additional reduction net of existing response; not the gross capacity of a curtailment program
nuclear_credit: zero default; EIA net-summer size is a physical ceiling for a restart, not an estimated incremental native capacity credit
gas_scope: consequence per 1 GW of assumed accredited gas contribution, not regional construction, dispatch or data-center attribution
